headerDisplay:
Controls the Bluetooth-only Dyson Solarcycle / Lightcycle Morph.

**The lamp must be registered in the MyDyson app.** Its key is issued by Dyson against the account the lamp belongs to and cannot be read from the device itself.

Each lamp becomes two accessories in the Home app: the light itself, and a second one holding the switches below. With every switch turned off, that second one is left out.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Homebridge log in front of this plugin’s messages.

adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Leave empty to use the system default adapter. Only needed when the machine has more than one, for example a USB dongle next to the built-in one. hciconfig lists them.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: Printed on the lamp base and shown in the MyDyson app.

autoBrightnessSwitch.title: Expose auto brightness
autoBrightnessSwitch.description: Adds a switch for the lamp's "Auto" setting, which trims brightness to keep the room at a steady level.

movementSwitch.title: Expose movement mode
movementSwitch.description: Adds a switch for the lamp's movement mode, where it lights on movement and goes out once the room has been still.

presetSwitches.title: Expose the preset modes
presetSwitches.description: Adds the lamp's Study, Relax and Precision modes as switches. Only one can be on at a time, which the lamp itself enforces.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Decimal degrees. The lamp works out sunrise and sunset from this, which is what daylight tracking follows.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Decimal degrees. Set both or neither — a lamp is not told half a location.

dayStart.title: Daytime start
dayStart.description: Optional. Replaces the real sunrise for this lamp — daylight tracking then begins here instead. Only used while "Use custom daytime" above is on.

dayEnd.title: Daytime end
dayEnd.description: Optional. Replaces the real sunset. The lamp returns to its baseline settings once daytime is over.

customDay.title: Use custom daytime
customDay.description: Puts the two times below in the lamp. Off, they are ignored and the lamp's daytime is not touched. Turning it off does not undo a daytime already written: the lamp keeps it until the MyDyson app sets it back.

yearOfBirth.title: Year of birth
yearOfBirth.description: Age adjustment: the lamp trims the brightness of its Study and Relax modes to suit the main user’s eyes. The lamp stores the year only, encrypted, and keeps it to the Dyson account that set it. Leave empty to leave the setting alone.

ageAdjust.title: Apply the age adjustment
ageAdjust.description: The lamp’s own switch for the age adjustment. Only used when a year of birth is set below. Turning it off leaves the year in the lamp but stops it acting on it.

daylightSwitch.title: Expose daylight tracking
daylightSwitch.description: Adds a switch for the lamp's daylight tracking, which adjusts colour temperature to the time of day. It reports the true state, following the button on the lamp base and the MyDyson app. Setting brightness or colour temperature by hand ends the tracking; that is the lamp's own rule.

footerDisplay: Lamp keys are stored in the plugin's storage directory, never in config.json. Your MyDyson password is only needed while authorising — clear it afterwards.
